FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTake:
You travel all over the place, don't you?
You're not driving your POKéMON too harshly, are you?
Let me take a look. … … …   … … …
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_HmmISeeIs: Ah, hmm… I see, I see…
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonR:
Oh, impressive. You treat your POKéMON right.
I think you can be entrusted with this.
Please, I'd like you to have this.
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_ReceivedE: {PLAYER} received an EGG from the man!
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveS:
…Unfortunately, you don't have space for this in your party.
You'd better come back for it another time.
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_YouveCome: やあ タマゴを　もらいに きて　くれたんだね
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetS:
I received that EGG while I was traveling.
I'm glad I met someone like you.
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRe:
Oh, hello. That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.
Seeing it reminds me of a sweet  little girl I met while traveling.
She was gently grooming POKéMON… She was a little angel.
That little girl's name… I think it was DAISY.
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntr: This is an excellent environment for raising POKéMON.
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefe: Your POKéMON are growing up admirably well!
FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePost: You know, I think you have the talent to be a good BREEDER.
